summary.text: Paul Kendrick is the Democratic candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Republican Justin Kumar for a seat with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described a background that includes policy work in the Obama White House and service on the Lincoln Park High School Local School Council.

paragraphs.text: Paul Kendrick's candidate survey says he worked on policy in the Obama White House and later served on the Lincoln Park High School Local School Council.
It describes him as a lifelong education advocate who organized neighbors through Indivisible after Donald Trump took office.
Kendrick won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary for District 12 with 47.5 percent of the vote, ahead of Litcy Kurisinkal, Karim Lakhani and Mac LeBuhn.
He listed his key campaign messages as keeping streets safe from crime, making life more affordable and standing up to the federal government.
He also named schools, transportation, fiscal health, reproductive freedom and immigrant rights among his policy interests.
